svg.title: Where a volume is computed fine
svg.desc: A slice of a volume's lattice: the coarse points four fine steps apart, the coarse cells a level passes through or comes within 10 percent of, those within a coarse step of a wire, and those reached by following the surface across a face, all computed fine; the rest stays coarse.
svg.text: A volume: coarse first, fine only where a surface can pass (a slice)
In 3D the same with cubes: about half the fine lattice computed on a real span.
